definitions.gloss: tenure; being in office; holding a position
definitions.explanation: The period during which someone holds an official position or office. Used for political leaders, executives, and other officials.

examples.japanese: {在任|ざいにん}{中|ちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Many reforms were carried out during their tenure.

examples.japanese: {在任|ざいにん}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧4⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧だった。
examples.english: The term of office was four years.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴代|れきだい}→歴代：13199_rekidai⟧⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧{在任|ざいにん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{安倍|あべ}{晋三|しんぞう}だ。
examples.english: Among all prime ministers, Abe Shinzo served the longest tenure.

notes: Composed of {在|ざい} (exist, be present) + {任|にん} (duty, appointment). A formal term used in political and business reporting. Common collocations: {在任|ざいにん}{中|ちゅう} (during one's tenure), {在任|ざいにん}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧ (period of office/tenure), {在任|ざいにん}⟦{日数|にっすう}→日数：12953_nissuu⟧ (number of days in office). Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{罪人|ざいにん}→罪人：13984_zainin⟧ (criminal, sinner), which has a completely different meaning and kanji. Similar terms: ⟦{在職|ざいしょく}→在職：12129_zaishoku⟧ (being employed/in a position — broader, includes non-official jobs), ⟦{任期|にんき}→任期：11553_ninki⟧ (term of office — the defined period rather than the act of holding office).
